body:
Ported ECOWAR's REFLUX cross-mod pub/sub primitive natively into SHANKPIT (own log, zero cross-repo dep). First dispatcher: reusable interact buttons (BTN_USE, edge-triggered, already-wired input path). First subscriber: LevelDoor.subscribe_button_id -- doors toggle purely on REFLUX_ACTION_BUTTON_PRESSED matches, ignoring proximity. Real inversion of control ('the bridge listens for a button the button has no idea the bridge exists'). Wired into both server and lobby. 13/13 tests green. SHANKPIT 41589f1.

⚓ ☃
title: REFLUX pub/sub + reusable interact buttons + button-doors (S485)
